_readme: Leads queue for the daily forward scan (lib/forward-leads.ts has the full spec).
Leads are pointers, never sources: each is verified through forward-scan verify() against its own event page; every published fact comes from that page. Never cite `source` or `note`.

Add a lead: {name, date (ISO, optional time: 2026-11-28T18:00), endDate? (ISO), venue, url? (the event's own organiser/venue/ticketing page; omit if unknown), note?, source (e.g. casa-da-musica-newsletter-2026-11), addedAt (ISO)}.

The scan writes status (pending|done|rejected), attempts, lastTriedAt, reason, eventSlug, resolvedAt — leave them out when adding. Up to 8 leads per run, before discovery; rejected after 3 failed runs; past-dated leads are dropped.
Read at runtime from GitHub main (no deploy needed): edits here are bookkeeping-only for the Vercel build step.
